messages:
harper: Noticed a small but consistent rise in hedged calls after the last policy rollout. p95 climbed ~18ms and hedges +1.5%. Traces point to routers making different decisions around the same request id.
mina: dug in - mismatch isn't just epoch. decision_id hashing differs because we include a non-deterministic tag in the snapshot metadata (build_ts). Routers evaluate policy graph and produce decision IDs; if two routers have semantically equivalent snapshots with different metadata the ids diverge.
lucas: oy. so even if the model routes are compatible, we still hedge because we think they're different. we should canonicalize the snapshot fingerprint used for decision_id. remove volatile fields and compute HMAC over canonical proto.
arjun: implementation idea: snapshot_wire = compact(delta) with fields ordered; snapshot_fingerprint = HMAC(k_snapshot_sig, snapshot_wire). policy-service stores and publishes fingerprint + stable_snapshot_id. Routers compare fingerprints rather than raw timestamps. That avoids spurious mismatch when only metadata drifts.
harper: love that. also propose sticky-routing augmentation: when a request sees a decision for stable_snapshot_id S, attach X-Decision-Fingerprint: S to downstream calls for the request lifetime so subsequent hops prefer compatible routes.
mina: caveat: when we push a delta-only snapshot that intentionally changes behavior, routers need a clear incompatibility policy. propose compatibility matrix: compatible|compatible_with_degradation|incompatible. policy-service computes this at compile time for each snapshot and publishes it. Routers use it to decide swap semantics.
lucas: migration notes: 1) canonicalization + fingerprint generation in policy-service (backfill historical snapshots for a few weeks), 2) routers: accept fingerprint header and add prefer/fallback logic, 3) telemetry: routing.fingerprint_mismatch_count, routing.sticky_hit_rate, routing.incompatible_swap_count.
arjun: rollout: land server-side snapshot canonicalizer behind feature flag; start publishing fingerprint in staging. update small subset of routers to read fingerprint and prefer same-fingerprint routes with 5ms bounded wait. run mixed-fingerprint sim for 24h. then 1% canary strict.
ops-bot: "policy-service v4 deployed (fingerprint-enabled) at 2026-04-02T14:03:00Z"
harper: extra ops protection: require signed snapshot (HMAC) and versioned id to avoid accidental drift from tooling. also emit a human-readable change-summary with the snapshot publish so oncall can quickly triage semantic changes.
mina: tests: unit tests for canonicalizer -> identical logic across languages; end-to-end sim using recorded workloads to ensure hedges drop. Also add an eval: run critical prompt set across old vs compacted snapshot to assert no semantic regression.
lucas: TL;DR action items:
- policy-service: implement snapshot canonicalizer + HMAC fingerprint + compatibility matrix (mina)
- routers: honor X-Decision-Fingerprint, add bounded prefer wait, sticky propagation (lucas)
- telemetry: ops tiles for fingerprint mismatches and sticky hit rate (harper)
- rollout: staging -> mixed sim -> 1% canary strict -> ramp (arjun)
harper: i'll open RFC follow-up with sequence diagram and a tiny proto for the canonical snapshot. ping me if you want to pair on the sim harness. :thumbsup:
